content.value_statement: Pull request descriptions often miss context, testing notes, and review guidance. This skill builds clear PR descriptions with summaries, checklists, metadata, and reviewer focus areas.
actual_capabilities: Reviews change context from diffs and commit history when available.
Drafts PR titles using conventional commit and scope patterns.
Creates structured summaries, motivation, technical details, and testing sections.
Adds review checklists, deployment notes, rollback notes, and related issue references.
Provides templates for feature, bug fix, refactor, and repository PR template workflows.
Highlights reviewer focus areas, estimated review time, and follow-up tasks.
limitations: It depends on accurate change context from the user or repository.
It cannot verify tests, deployments, or screenshots unless evidence is provided.
Generated issue links and reviewer names need human confirmation.
It does not replace review judgment or team-specific approval rules.

use_cases.title: Prepare Feature PRs
use_cases.description: Create complete descriptions for new features with motivation, technical choices, test coverage, and rollout notes.

use_cases.title: Document Bug Fixes
use_cases.description: Explain the issue, root cause, fix, verification steps, and regression coverage in a reviewer-friendly format.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Templates
use_cases.description: Build reusable pull request templates that match team expectations for testing, documentation, and deployment readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic PR Description
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short description from a simple change summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pr-template-generator to draft a pull request description for this change: [describe the change]. Include summary, testing, and checklist sections.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Feature PR
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a new feature with reviewer context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pr-template-generator for a feature PR. Include motivation, technical approach, affected components, screenshots needed, tests performed, deployment notes, and reviewer focus areas.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Bug Fix
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a production bug fix.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pr-template-generator to document this bug fix. Include impact, root cause, solution, reproduction steps, verification steps, regression tests, rollout plan, and rollback plan.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Team PR Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a reusable repository template.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pr-template-generator to create a team pull request template for [team or repository]. Include sections for change type, context, tests, risks, deployment, screenshots, reviewers, and open questions.

output_examples.input: A checkout bug fix that prevents discounts from making order totals negative.
output_examples.output: A PR description with a clear bug summary, customer impact, root cause, fix explanation, test coverage, deployment notes, and rollback plan.

output_examples.input: A new notification feature with backend, frontend, and deployment changes.
output_examples.output: A feature PR description covering user value, architecture, changed components, dependencies, testing evidence, screenshots, configuration, and reviewer focus areas.

output_examples.input: A large refactor of payment provider logic with no behavior changes.
output_examples.output: A refactor PR description that explains goals, before and after structure, compatibility, risk level, test coverage, metrics, and follow-up work.

best_practices: Provide the diff, commit list, related issues, and any test results before asking for the PR description.
Review generated checklists and remove items that do not apply to the actual change.
Confirm deployment, rollback, reviewer, and screenshot details before publishing the PR.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated issue links, reviewers, or test claims without checking them.
Do not use a long template for a small change that needs a short review.
Do not hide breaking changes, migration steps, or production risks in generic text.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates structured pull request descriptions, titles, checklists, testing notes, and reviewer guidance.

faq.question: Does it inspect my repository automatically?
faq.answer: It can use repository context when the connected tool provides diffs or commit history. Otherwise, provide the change summary.

faq.question: Can it create GitHub pull request templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for reusable repository PR templates with standard sections and checklist items.

faq.question: Can it verify that tests passed?
faq.answer: No. It can document test results you provide, but it cannot verify claims without actual evidence.

faq.question: Which tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it suitable for large refactors?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes refactor-focused sections for motivation, compatibility, risks, metrics, and reviewer focus areas.
